account.title: Account
account.optional: Optional. Without an account everything stays in this browser.
account.inviteHelp: Accounts are in a closed beta, by invitation only.
account.privacy: While you are signed in, the documents you edit are also stored on the server, protected by HTTPS and encrypted at rest, but not end-to-end encrypted. Do not store personal data of respondents there. Work done before signing in stays in this browser until you edit it.
account.signedInNote: Documents you edit are saved to your account automatically and appear on your other devices. No save button needed.

err.bad_email: That e-mail address does not look right.
err.weak_password: Use a password of at least 10 characters.
err.invalid_invite: This invitation code is invalid, used or expired.
err.email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
err.server_error: Something went wrong. Try again later.

cloud.conflict: This document was changed on another device. The other version is kept as a separate copy.
cloud.quotaFull: Your cloud storage is full. This document stays in this browser only.
cloud.tooLarge: This document is too large for the cloud and stays in this browser only.
cloud.sessionEnded: You were signed out. Your work stays in this browser.

migrate.title: Bring your work into your account
migrate.intro: Choose what to move from this browser. Nothing is removed from here.
migrate.docsHelp: Documents you do not choose stay in this browser only and are never uploaded. New documents you create while signed in are saved to your account.
migrate.saveSettings: Save this browser's settings to my account
migrate.saveSettingsHelp: Language, theme, appearance and profile follow you to your other devices.
migrate.useAccountSettings: Use the settings from my account
migrate.useAccountSettingsHelp: Replaces the settings in this browser with the ones saved in your account.
migrate.replaceAccountSettings: Use this browser's settings and replace the ones in my account
migrate.replaceAccountSettingsHelp: Your other devices will pick up these settings.
migrate.keepSeparate: Keep the settings separate (do not sync them)
